name: Sandpiper
summary: A web app that uses language models to annotate tutoring transcripts with a research team's codes, masking personal information first, and compares the annotations with people's coding.
access_note: Self-hosting needs MongoDB, Redis and model provider keys; the hosted instance needs a sign-in and paid credits. Transcripts go to commercial model providers.
cite: Hedley, D., Pietrzak, D., Dias, J., Burden, I., Ahtisham, B., Zhou, Z., Vanacore, K., Marland, J., Slama, R., Reich, J., Koedinger, K., & Kizilcec, R. (2026). Sandpiper: Orchestrated AI-Annotation for Educational Discourse at Scale. arXiv:2603.08406

fits.how: Its coding schemes and agreement checks are how a detector is judged: against people's labels on a sample.
